architecture.windowSurface: Create one native Editor per window outside view(c); show via public NativeView. Never allocate per session or use private MyGo lifecycle APIs.
architecture.documentStore: Window-owned adapter retains semantic documents independently of NSView: key = accountScope + HostID + SessionID + draftSlot(main or queue:itemId). This key is stable across reconnect. callback epoch separately captures window generation, account, Host, transport generation, navigation and active slot.
architecture.authoritativeEditing: Native surface owns active editing and undo; Go DocumentStore owns captured semantic snapshots, semantic revision and pending receipts. a.draft is a compatibility canonical mirror only. Do not call scope or setAttributedString on each frame/native change.
architecture.submission: A production send gesture reads one current validated native snapshot, captures semantic document identity/revision/runs plus exact existing AttachmentIDs, then routes through existing composerSubmit/sendComposerPayload/sendPayload and durable intent machinery. Swift never sends RPC.
architecture.retainedUI: Retain native composer card, existing image rail/lightbox/intake, queue dock, approval forms, model WK anchor and permission confirmation. Replace only text surface and old Element editing operations via a small document adapter.
architecture.receiptAdapter: Extend captured intent/document settlement rather than implement a second ledger. Current acceptSend only changes a.draft/drafts and image IDs; adapter must apply settlement to captured semantic DocumentStore and the native surface only if still active and semantically CAS-valid.
architecture.fallback: Keep existing default widget until root actual-GUI gates pass. Feature flag must preserve the same Go content/image/receipt path; not switch entire composer to permanent WK.

newComponentFacts.savedDocuments: Every scope stores NSAttributedString + NSRange + UndoManager in strong dictionary, with no forget/account retirement/eviction command.
newComponentFacts.surfaceCount: 50 scopes on one NSView demonstrates constant surface allocation only, not bounded documents/undo/heap/native/GPU memory.
newComponentFacts.close: close() sets text.owner=nil before text.undoManager.removeAllActions(); override then resolves to ownUndo, not current documentUndo. No explicit loop removes all saved manager actions/documents. This is a concrete cleanup gap, not proof of a retain cycle.

twoLevelPolicy.semanticDraft: Go store retains unsent semantic content/selection/attachment IDs safely by account/Host/session/slot, independently of whether any NSUndoManager is hot. Persist through existing/new self-owned prefs boundary if restart preservation is required. Never evict unsent content by LRU.
twoLevelPolicy.hotUndo: Keep UndoManager only while its document/session is intentionally retained, matching retained original session scopes. Define explicit retain/release bindings and document retirement; do not silently cap arbitrary accessed docs and claim parity. Pressure trimming may export semantic draft then retire cold native undo only when policy is explicit and tested.
twoLevelPolicy.account: Current adoptAccountScope preserves old account canonical draft in namespaced Go map while clearing active identity/Host/selection. Before retiring native old account, export full semantic draft/selection and in-flight receipts; drop old native attributed/Undo/transfer handles, fence callbacks. Do not silently delete old-account unsent draft.
twoLevelPolicy.window: On close synchronously invalidate callback owner/epoch, stop native edits/marked state, close all transfer handles; explicitly removeAllActions on current and every saved manager, clear savedDocuments and delegate/owner, then release bridge owner. MyGo foreign embed/window teardown retains raw view according to public host lifetime; measure its release separately.
twoLevelPolicy.session: On real session-scope retirement persist semantic draft before explicit forget(docKey); simple A/B navigation is not automatically retirement and must preserve retained Undo.
